info.name: DART Recon Pipeline (new)
info.description:
End-to-end recon pipeline for new DART FastAPI (`/api/v1`).

How to run: open folder 0, send **001 Health**, then send the request named in NEXT. Login (JSON) is required. Poll requests: resend until status is completed.

Skip unless you need them: OAuth2 login, Refresh token, Unlink GV, JE upload, Import sync CSV, Delete workflow, Cleanup.

baseUrl and login live in collection variables — no separate environment file.

Run requests in this numbered order. Each request description says NEXT.

## 0. Auth
001 · Health
002 · Health detailed
003 · Login (JSON)
004 · Login (OAuth2 form / Swagger)
005 · Refresh token
006 · Current user
## 1. Prerequisites — group and global variable
007 · List my groups
008 · List groups
009 · Create group
010 · Get group
011 · Group details
012 · Rename group

## 2. Select — create recon

## 3. Dimension Linking — applications

## 4. Dimension Linking — dimensions

## 5. Run Import

046 · Upload App 2 file
047 · Poll App 2 import run
048 · List import history
049 · List imported rows (App 1)
050 · List imported rows (App 2)

052 · Export imported data CSV (App 1)
053 · Upload App 1 as journal entry (optional)
## 6. Bridge Members

057 · Import bridge CSV App 2 (Mock)
058 · Create bridge mapping (extra)
059 · List bridge mappings App 1

061 · Update bridge mapping
062 · Export bridge mappings App 1
063 · Export bridge mappings (all apps)
064 · Start bridge run

## 7. Transformation

## 8. Run Report

## 10. Recon audit

item.name: 0. Auth
item.description:
Send 001 · Health through 006 · Current user in order. Each request says NEXT.

Required first. JSON login is what the UI uses. Writes access_token.

request.description:
STEP 1 of 132  —  folder 0. Auth

Confirms the API is up. No token needed.

NEXT (002): GET  002 · Health detailed

STEP 2 of 132  —  folder 0. Auth

Confirms Postgres and Redis. No token needed.

NEXT (003): POST  003 · Login (JSON)

STEP 3 of 132  —  folder 0. Auth

Required. Saves access_token and refresh_token. Use this, not the OAuth2 login, for the rest of the run.

NEXT (006): GET  006 · Current user

Skip 004 OAuth2 login and 005 Refresh unless the token expired.

Skip this unless the token expired. After Login (JSON) go to Current user.
